name: expense-pilot
description: A clearer view of every dollar. Self-hosted Australian employment and business expenses, receipt review, invoices, quotes, budgets, vehicle records and overnight spending. Optional receipt AI, PocketSmith bank feeds and email use your own configured services. No Expense Pilot cloud account is required. Prepare the appdata folder as described in the installation guide. Create your owner account on your trusted network before enabling remote access. The setup token is optional and AI is configured inside the app. The optional iPhone companion remains in testing.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent database, receipts and session key. Keep this mapping during updates.

variables.name: Setup token
variables.description: Optional first-run protection. Leave blank for token-free setup, or enter a random value of at least 24 characters. Complete owner setup before exposing the server remotely.

variables.name: Secure cookie
variables.description: Use true behind HTTPS. Use false for initial LAN HTTP setup.
